description: A directory holding one loadable catalog and a FIFO named like a catalog. Reaches parseLocalizedStringsFile:1757 through the directory walk, which CONTRADICTS that branch's own disposition (it argued the guard was unreachable because :1247 had already skipped directories -- a FIFO is not a directory). Measured on the pinned JDK with a timeout: Files.isRegularFile is a stat and runs before Files.newInputStream, so the oracle refuses rather than blocking on an unopened pipe.
